methodology: Equal-weight accepted roadmap packages. Submissions and partial work do not count as product completion.

packages.title: Preserved baseline and evidence
packages.acceptance: Preserve approved source, recovered maps, signatures and profile/settings snapshots. Every test receipt identifies commit, APK/map hashes, device/OS and truck inputs. Restore/recovery remains possible.

packages.title: Current native failure inventory
packages.acceptance: Run current native profile/ADR, navigation, GPS, interface, parking and import suites. Reproduce the historical ADR-C case first. Record individual outcomes and isolated reproductions; an incomplete suite cannot be called passing.

packages.title: Reproducible build and CI
packages.acceptance: Prove a fresh-checkout Windows/CI build without hidden fixtures or skipped tooling tests. Reconcile compile-SDK and CI provisioning; classify lint warnings and fix correctness/platform issues. Keep source/dependency versions explicit.

packages.title: Isolated approved-interface QA build
packages.acceptance: Create a clearly labeled isolated QA build of the approved interface with separate IDs/storage. Verify UI identity. Preserve original EuroRig/Eurowag data; physical devices never run data-clearing smoke scripts.

packages.title: Truck and ADR capability matrix
packages.acceptance: Create the complete standard-truck/ADR capability matrix: rigid, tractor/semitrailer, drawbar, trailer configuration, total dimensions, loaded/permitted mass, axle loads/counts and cargo/tunnel inputs. Map each field to engine enforcement, added audit or explicit unsupported status. Test boundary/equality/contradictory inputs; close the 200 t/100 t mismatch without inventing support.

packages.title: Verified ADR detours
packages.acceptance: Resolve any reproduced ADR legal-detour failures. Keep prohibited edges excluded; independently verify the expected corridor. Cover expensive legal approaches, endpoint changes and every routing preference. Find a verified legal detour or establish why the expectation is invalid; never relax a hard restriction for a pass.

packages.title: Turns, dimensions and hard restrictions
packages.acceptance: Verify imported/native/audited node and via-way turns, no/only rules, multiple via ways, direction, access hierarchy, dimensions, gross/axle loads and trailers. Use actual path-history fixtures and conflicting/unknown cases. All preferences, alternatives and reroutes enforce identical hard rules.

packages.title: Destination-bound delivery access
packages.acceptance: Verify private/delivery/final-approach permissions through stops, expiry, revocation, profile changes and reroutes. Intermediate stops never grant trip-wide permission. Routing and restricted-road paint agree; stale authorization cannot remain valid during GPS loss.

packages.title: Bulk restriction sources and coverage
packages.acceptance: Build the reusable bulk-source pipeline described in section 7: one shared rule model, adapters by source format, country configuration, dated provenance, exact road/zone matching and an exception queue. Audit national and municipal coverage automatically. Maintain the RO/MD source register; proposals, expired notices and ambiguous matches are not current restrictions. Manual city-by-city compilation is not the delivery strategy.

packages.title: Conditional rules and timezones
packages.acceptance: Add/verify timezone/admin support and scheduled/conditional restrictions, applicable holidays, access zones, exemptions and country/load rules. Validate dated authoritative fixtures. Unknown conditions remain explicit and conservative; missing data is never represented as proven clearance.

packages.title: Coherent Romania–Moldova maps
packages.acceptance: Verify/build a coherent RO–MD graph/display package with compatible tile identities/hierarchy and source manifests. Test border approaches in both directions for representative truck/ADR profiles. Do not concatenate independently built country TARs.

packages.title: Import, update and rollback
packages.acceptance: Validate install, selection, download/resume, manual import, update and rollback. Cover low storage, interruption, corrupt/truncated entries, path/duplicate entries and schema/engine mismatch. Failed updates preserve a usable previous map after restart.

packages.title: Search, entrances and coverage metadata
packages.acceptance: Align search, map and restriction metadata. Show installed coverage/source dates and known limits. Test addresses, depots, POIs and precise coordinates in both countries; establish the actual truck entrance and disclose unusable/missing entrances.

packages.title: Free distribution and manual import
packages.acceptance: Establish free release hosting plus manual-import fallback, respecting licenses, hashes, artifact limits and update compatibility. Core navigation remains usable when hosting is unavailable. Document storage requirements and retention/rollback behavior.

packages.title: GPS matching and valid starts
packages.acceptance: Verify accurate/fresh start fixes, endpoint correlation and sequence-based GPS matching at parallel roads, ramps, roundabouts and complex junctions. Keep exact-route audit matching distinct from live GPS matching. Replay noise, sparse fixes, stops and reverse travel against labeled paths; retain strict geometry/profile validation in fallbacks.

packages.title: Reliable missed-turn rerouting
packages.acceptance: Make missed-turn rerouting stable, bounded and cancellable. Preserve truck, access, final destination and all unvisited stops. Test stale asynchronous results, repeat deviations and no lawful alternative. No car fallback, wrong-way recovery, reroute storm or silent stop loss.

packages.title: GPS loss and Android lifecycle
packages.acceptance: Handle GPS loss/tunnels, coarse permission, stale/future/nonfinite fixes, provider disable/revocation, background/screen-off and battery restrictions. Show lost confidence; recover from valid fixes only. Do not fabricate location/progress or confuse route simulation with real GPS.

packages.title: Confirmed trip restoration
packages.acceptance: Persist minimal trip intent/stop progress. On kill/restart, restore, recheck map/profile/permissions, obtain a fresh fix and ask to resume. Test expired access and map/profile changes while stopped. No silent guidance restart.

packages.title: Maneuvers and lane advice
packages.acceptance: Verify maneuver timing, roundabout exits, current-road/speed information and recorded lane/signpost advice. Cover merges, close turns and truck-prohibited lanes. Missing lane evidence stays absent/limited rather than fabricated.

packages.title: Romanian/English UI and offline speech
packages.acceptance: Complete RO/EN UI resources, maneuver language and actual offline speech. Test street names/numbers, language switching, absent voice packs, mute, notification Stop and audio interruption. A configured TTS object alone does not prove audible guidance.

packages.title: Ten ordered intermediate stops
packages.acceptance: Ten intermediate stops plus endpoints. Implement drag-and-drop order, visible numbering and accessible move-up/down actions. Preserve chosen order through editing, saving, rerouting and restart. Test 0/1/5/10 stops, duplicate/crossed locations, removal and cancellation. Never optimize order automatically.

packages.title: Audited two-point alternatives
packages.acceptance: Add native two-point alternative selection: primary plus up to two meaningful lawful alternatives where available. Shared road sections are allowed. Deduplicate; apply identical profile/permission audits; show distance/ETA/restrictions. Fewer valid alternatives are reported honestly.

packages.title: Ordered multi-stop alternatives
packages.acceptance: Prove ordered multi-stop alternatives against the pinned engine. If native multipoint alternatives are unsupported, generate bounded leg candidates and audit the whole joined trip. Preserve every stop/order/permission; avoid exponential combinations. Test leg joins, shared approaches and single-lawful-route cases.

packages.title: Static truck parking
packages.acceptance: Build usable static RO–MD truck-parking coverage from licensed free sources. Record truck entrances, carriageway/direction, access/size evidence, amenities and dates. Rank by truck-drivable detour. Test wrong-carriageway and unreachable sites; unknown ADR acceptance/capacity stays unknown.

packages.title: Optional parking occupancy
packages.acceptance: Integrate occupancy only for verified covered sites. Validate measurement timestamps, stale/offline cache, invalid counts and outage. Unknown availability never becomes a live vacancy claim. The existing NDW adapter retains its actual geographic scope.

packages.title: Optional toll estimates
packages.acceptance: Research verified free toll/vignette/bridge/ferry sources. Covered estimates record category, period, currency, tariff date and exclusions; independent examples reproduce totals. Uncovered charges or missing inputs show unavailable/incomplete, never fabricated zero cost. No payment flow is needed.

packages.title: Optional live traffic
packages.acceptance: Assess free traffic/closure feed rights, freshness, coverage and road matching. Test stale/bad data and outages. Any traffic-driven reroute receives the full truck audit. Offline navigation never waits for the feed.

packages.title: Independent comparison corpus
packages.acceptance: Define public-coordinate scenarios and identical input sheets: app/map versions, truck/load/ADR, exact endpoints/stops, preferences and traffic state. Unsupported or mismatched reference options are not scored as equivalent tests.

packages.title: Authorized Eurowag comparison
packages.acceptance: Compare through authorized Eurowag UI. Record route/refusal, principal roads, endpoint snaps, restrictions, stop order, parking entrance and ETA assumptions. Investigate safety differences against authoritative evidence. Do not copy proprietary code, maps, artwork, voices or restricted datasets.

packages.title: Tablet qualification
packages.acceptance: Run Tab S9 matrix across languages, themes, orientations, permission states, offline use, stops, alternatives, parking and lifecycle failure. Save actual assertions and APK/map/device receipts in private storage.

packages.title: Physical Pixel qualification
packages.acceptance: Repeat on the physical Pixel 8 Pro and its actual OS/ABI/page size. Test phone layouts, calls/audio interruption, screen-off/background and memory independently. Tablet/emulator results do not close this device gate.

packages.title: Soak and performance evidence
packages.acceptance: Run tablet replay/soak first, then repeat on the Pixel after F4. Measure routing/rerouting, render frames, memory, battery and thermal state. Fix crashes, ANRs, route/stop loss and unbounded growth. Completion for both devices requires both sets of receipts; publish no universal FPS claim.

packages.title: Private release candidate
packages.acceptance: Produce private signed candidate, support/coverage matrix, limits, evidence, installation/storage and rollback instructions. Test fresh install and upgrades retaining maps/profiles. Keep signing keys private and recoverable.

packages.title: Maintenance and data updates
packages.acceptance: Establish source/map/dependency review, regression reruns, feed expiry and issue reproduction. Trace every restriction report to APK, map, truck and source record. No new location telemetry by default.

packages.title: Broader European coverage
packages.acceptance: Expand Europe country by country, excluding Russia. Each needs licensing/provenance, coherent border maps, country/load fixtures and comparison tests. Choose country order and Turkey/Caucasus coverage later with the owner.

packages.title: Later public distribution
packages.acceptance: Prepare public distribution, update/signing/security/support, contribution and licensing policies. Keep the app free. Wider Android/API support requires separate evidence; API 26 renderer problems are a later public-scope gate.

packages.title: Later permit-dependent loads
packages.acceptance: Add permit-dependent abnormal loads, specialized trailer/axle/swept-path models and extended freight/ferry cases through a separate capability matrix. A declaration never creates clearance or replaces an individual permit.

batches.title: Baseline and CI evidence
batches.deliverable: Reconcile source/build/CI/test/fixture versions; index existing receipts and all current lint records. Separate completed QA isolation from missing checks. Required outputs: `baseline.json`, exact lint occurrence multiset/counts, CI provisioning diff, source references, unresolved-check index.

batches.title: Truck/ADR/access evidence
batches.deliverable: Extend the reviewed 14-field source index into UI/storage/native/audit/test trace rows. Inventory truck/ADR/access/turn fixtures and contradictory or unsupported inputs. Required outputs: Per-field exact paths/lines/snippets/units, fixture-to-assertion map, capability questions, model/native discrepancy evidence. Do not decide legal support.

batches.title: Bulk-source discovery and normalization
batches.deliverable: Collect bulk authority-source candidates by country/region and group reusable formats. Parse available licensed/public samples, index restrictions and update metadata, and identify exact matching keys. Prioritize RO/MD; do not research every city manually. Required outputs: `sources.jsonl`, source snapshots/hashes where permitted, schema samples, adapter-format groups, unresolved rights/currentness/location fields, source-change candidates. No accepted legal rules or map joins.

batches.title: Map/import fixture preparation
batches.deliverable: Inventory public/synthetic map manifests, package schemas, source dates and build/import failure cases. Prepare compatible corruption/truncation/duplicate-entry candidates in the sandbox. Required outputs: Package/source matrix, fixture generator candidates, expected structural failures with source references, download/import test matrix. No large map rebuild without an explicit bounded recipe.

batches.title: GPS/recovery replay preparation
batches.deliverable: Prepare public/synthetic GPS/recovery replay inputs and classify sanitized logs supplied outside private storage. Enumerate stale callbacks, GPS gaps, restart and authorization-expiry cases. Required outputs: Replay JSONL/schema, origin/provenance per point, case matrix, error index. Expected live-route/legality outcomes stay unknown without an independent Codex oracle.

batches.title: RO/EN and maneuver drafts
batches.deliverable: Finish exact UI/resource inventories and RO translation drafts; index maneuver/lane/TTS cases. Reuse the corrected 89-entry candidate resources. Required outputs: Translation/key/source map, preserved placeholder contracts, candidate XML, terminology/safety ambiguities, speech/pronunciation test inputs. Compile with actual Android tools if available; do not wire production UI.

batches.title: Stop/alternative scenarios
batches.deliverable: Prepare ordered-stop and route-alternative combinations: 0/1/5/10 intermediate stops, duplicate/crossed locations, removals, cancellation, leg joins and a single lawful-route case. Required outputs: Deduplicated scenario records and expected structural invariants. Preserve chosen order; no automatic optimization or invented shortest-path/legal oracle.

batches.title: Parking/toll/traffic sources
batches.deliverable: Collect free parking/occupancy/toll/traffic source leads and sample schemas, dates, units, currencies, geographic scope and outage states. Required outputs: Separate static/dynamic source registers, exact publisher references, licensing/freshness gaps, candidate records with unknown fields explicit. No tariff/legal inference or claim that traffic feeds cover permanent HGV rules.

batches.title: Comparison corpus preparation
batches.deliverable: Consolidate exact public/synthetic comparison points, profiles, ordered stops and per-country switches. Reuse reviewed W06 endpoints; keep unprovided option values unknown. Required outputs: Scenario schema/validator, point provenance, comparison input sheets, missing-oracle list. Count scenarios separately from mode/profile parameterizations. No unperformed Eurowag comparison pass.

batches.title: Device/log matrix preparation
batches.deliverable: Prepare test matrices and machine-readable result summaries for available tablet/emulator and later Pixel tests. Analyze only provided nonprivate logs. Required outputs: Case/receipt index, actual timing/count summaries, failures vs warnings/skips/missing evidence, hardware prerequisites. Pixel and road tests remain unperformed without actual receipts.

batches.title: Release/expansion preparation
batches.deliverable: Inventory notices, artifact manifests, source update/check requirements, release instructions and future country/permit-load data needs. Required outputs: Release-preparation checklist, notice/source inventory, compatibility questions and expansion/source-format matrix. No signing, publication, security approval or new scope decision.

batches.title: Reverse-engineering archive analysis
batches.deliverable: Read the pinned EurowagNav archive and classify existing findings as current, superseded, unverified or missing artifacts. Extract behavior/interface questions and public feed leads in bulk. Required outputs: Technology/behavior matrix with exact evidence references, reproduction inputs and priority questions. Existing destination authorization is not new work. Do not execute extraction/probe scripts or infer deployed behavior from symbols alone.
